required_manual_checks.description: Derive the exact server-phase requirements from the 2G.1 manifest and real startup reader. Add ASCEND_VAULT_PATH only where the startup suite requires it; keep the render-isolation suite independent of database authority. Preserve the real route, Server Component, barrier, and mutant proofs without Sales or runtime edits.

Use COORD-PROOF-001 orchestration to read only the private ignored local ASCEND_VAULT_PATH input, require it to be present and usable, and pass it only to the server proof child with the already sanctioned server inputs. The local input remains ignored and private; never commit or print its value. Provision the same sanctioned input separately in the COORD-SERVER-001 worktree before proving; do not read from or alter the frozen 2A.2e candidate.

Preserve the previously authorized read-only production-host contact for startup server proof only. Do not mutate production, run migrations, or create production fixtures. Pass no recovery, migration, hardening, owner, backup, direct database, or unrelated secrets into the server child. Keep server, DB, recovery, migration, and owner authority separate and fail closed when required inputs are absent.

Test that database URLs, passwords, session secrets, vault paths, and other sensitive values do not appear in Coordinator events, result fields, proof receipts, or logs, including failure paths. Allowlist child output and keep exact-tree receipt validation unchanged.

Prove server phase succeeds with the sanctioned private vault-path input and refuses its absence; test server variable allowlist, prohibited authority exclusion, no production mutation, secret-free output, unchanged exact-tree receipt behavior, and failure preventing READY or FREEZE. Run focused Coordinator and architecture controls, typecheck, and the complete server phase on the exact candidate tree. Do not claim a receipt from a focused diagnostic.
